name: Syside
description: A SysML v2 tool family combining VS Code textual editing, interactive graphical and grid views, and a Python API for model automation.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina SysML v2 tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: Sensmetry开发的原生SysML v2工具系列，目前是文本式SysML v2工具中成熟度较高的一套。主要分为Syside Editor、Syside Modeler和Syside Automator。Editor提供VS Code中的SysML v2/KerML文本编辑、语法检查、自动完成、导航等；Modeler在此基础上增加交互式图形视图和Grid View；Automator提供Python API，用于模型查询、计算、测试和自动化。

collaboration.note: The product page describes real-time collaborative editing and version-control integration.

codeGeneration.note: Code generation is provided through Syside Automator templates and Python interfaces.

simulation.note: The paid product family describes model execution, analysis, and behavior simulation.

requirementsManagement.note: ReqIF exchange and requirement-satisfaction traceability are available in the automation product.

sysmlV2Api.note: The product page describes integration through SysML v2 APIs.

classificationNotes: This record covers the current Syside family. The deprecated Syside Editor Legacy codebase is a separate archived LGPL project.
